description: This file defines the 'DebugSettings' SwiftUI view which provides diagnostic and debugging tools within an OpenClaw macOS application. It includes sections for app info, gateway control, logs, port diagnostics, configuration paths, quick actions, and Canvas debugging features. The file references external management classes and performs UI interactions for debugging purposes.

classes.name: PlainSettingsGroupBoxStyle
classes.description: Custom SwiftUI GroupBoxStyle for consistent styling of sections in the debug settings UI.

methods.name: runPortCheck
methods.description: Performs asynchronous port diagnostics check and updates the UI with the results.

methods.name: resetGatewayTunnel
methods.description: Resets the SSH tunnel for the gateway and updates the status display.

methods.name: requestKill
methods.description: Handles requests to terminate port listener processes, with prompts for expected listeners.

methods.name: killConfirmed
methods.description: Confirms and executes a process kill given its PID, updating port status.

methods.name: chooseCatalogFile
methods.description: Opens a file dialog for selecting a model catalog file and reloads models.

methods.name: reloadModels
methods.description: Loads model catalog data asynchronously and updates the model count or error message.

methods.name: sendVoiceDebug
methods.description: Sends a debug voice command asynchronously and updates status or error messages.

methods.name: revealApp
methods.description: Reveals the application's bundle in Finder.

methods.name: saveRelayRoot
methods.description: Saves the gateway project root path.

methods.name: loadSessionStorePath
methods.description: Loads session store path from configuration.

methods.name: saveSessionStorePath
methods.description: Saves the current session store path into configuration.

methods.name: canvasPresent
methods.description: Displays a directory for the Canvas session and its contents.

methods.name: canvasWriteSamplePage
methods.description: Generates and writes a sample HTML page for Canvas debugging.

methods.name: canvasEval
methods.description: Evaluates JavaScript in the Canvas session and displays the result.

methods.name: canvasSnapshot
methods.description: Takes a snapshot of the Canvas view and provides the file path.
